'''Acme Droid Service''' was a business operating in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine]]. It was run by an aggressive [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Unidentified Acme Droid Service salesman|salesman]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] hid from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] within the building.<ref name="Droids" />

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Acme Droid Service appeared in the [[Droids (1986) 7|seventh]] issue of the [[1986]] [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The issue was written by [[David Manak]] and [[George Carragone]] and was published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="Droids" /> on [[January 13]], [[1987]].<ref name="Marvel Age">''[[Marvel Age]]'' 48</ref>
